faq.question: Do I keep the dashboard after delivery?
faq.answer: Yes, completely. It is built in your own Looker Studio and connected to your own GA4, so the file belongs to you. You can edit it, share it, or hand it to someone else. Nothing is locked to me and there is no subscription.

faq.question: Does it cost anything to run?
faq.answer: No. Looker Studio is free, and the GA4, Google Ads and Search Console connectors are Google's own native ones, also free. I deliberately avoid paid third-party connectors so you do not inherit a monthly bill.

faq.question: Can you include Facebook or Meta ad data?
faq.answer: Not honestly, not for free. Meta has no native Looker Studio connector, so it needs a paid third-party one such as Supermetrics. I would rather tell you that than quietly add a monthly cost. Google sources I can combine at no charge.

faq.question: What if my GA4 data looks wrong?
faq.answer: Then a dashboard will only display the problem more clearly. Send me your site and I will check whether events and revenue are actually being recorded properly. If they are not, fixing the tracking comes first and I will tell you so.

faq.question: What access do you need from me?
faq.answer: Viewer access to your GA4 property is enough for Basic and Standard. Premium also needs read access to Google Ads and Search Console. An invite is fine, and I never need your passwords.
